analogy.rationale: MMP inhibitors block secreted/extracellular proteases whose transcriptional footprint in these cell lines is minimal, so the closest match is the synonymous matrix metalloprotease inhibitor class, with weak overlap to angiogenesis/VEGFR and TGF-beta pathways that intersect MMP biology.
